name: GHA Simulation #1 — Recruiter-Email Likert Format
description: 65 Likert-style work-behavior items, matching the 60–70 Likert description in the recruiter email as closely as possible.

name: GHA Simulation #2 — Ambiguity & Execution
description: A fresh general-workplace set with more emphasis on uncertainty, ownership, execution, and decision-making.

name: GHA Simulation #3 — Collaboration & Learning
description: A fresh general-workplace set with more emphasis on communication, collaboration, feedback, inclusion, and adaptability.

name: GHA Simulation #4 — Integrity & Judgment
description: A fresh general-workplace set with more emphasis on integrity, confidentiality, quality, policy, and judgment under pressure.
